title: Smooth algebras descend through filtered colimits of rings
statement: Let $I$ be a small filtered category and $i\mapsto A_i$ a functor from $I$ to commutative rings with colimit $A=\varinjlim_IA_i$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] and coprojections $\iota_i:A_i\to A$. Let $A\to B$ be a smooth ring map [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]. Then there are an index $i\in I$, a smooth ring map $A_i\to B_i$ [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map] and an isomorphism of $A$-algebras $B\cong A\otimes_{A_i}B_i$ (tensor product formed via $\iota_i$).

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 0CAQ (lemma-smooth-descends-through-colimit, line 38230); its proof: 'Follows from Lemma 00TP (lemma-finite-presentation-fs-Noetherian: a smooth $R\to S$ is the base change of a smooth $R_0\to S_0$ with $R_0$ of finite type over $\mathbf Z$) since $R_0\to A$ will factor through $A_i$ for some $i$ by Lemma 00QO (lemma-characterize-finite-presentation)'. Same shape as the étale case (node lem-weil-pbc-etale-algebra-filtered-colimit-descent), Lemma 00U2 (9)

proof.text: *A model over a finitely generated subring (Stacks: 'Follows from Lemma 00TP').* By [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-algebra-finite-type-model] applied to the smooth ring map $A\to B$ there are a subring $A_0\subseteq A$ generated as a ring by finitely many elements, with inclusion $j:A_0\to A$, a smooth ring map $A_0\to B_0$ [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], and an isomorphism of $A$-algebras $\varphi:B\xrightarrow{\sim}A\otimes_{A_0}B_0$, where $A$ is an $A_0$-algebra via $j$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 00TP (lemma-finite-presentation-fs-Noetherian), as used in the proof of Lemma Tag 0CAQ

proof.text: *The model ring factors through a stage (Stacks: '$R_0\to A$ will factor through $A_i$ for some $i$ by Lemma 00QO').* $A_0$ is generated as a ring by finitely many elements (step 1), i.e. of finite type over $\mathbf Z$. By [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-ring-map-factors-filtered-colimit] (1), applied to the filtered colimit $A=\varinjlim_IA_i$ with coprojections $\iota_i$ and the ring map $h=j:A_0\to A$, there are $i\in I$ and a ring map $g:A_0\to A_i$ with $\iota_i\circ g=j$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0CAQ (lemma-smooth-descends-through-colimit), proof: 'Follows from Lemma 00TP since $R_0\to A$ will factor through $A_i$ for some $i$ by Lemma 00QO'

proof.text: *The smooth algebra over the stage (Stacks: implicit).* Regard $A_i$ as an $A_0$-algebra via $g$ and put $B_i=A_i\otimes_{A_0}B_0$, an $A_i$-algebra via $a\mapsto a\otimes1$. By [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map-base-change-composition] (1) (with $R=A_0$, $S=B_0$, $R'=A_i$), the ring map $A_i\to B_i$ is smooth.

source.place: Lemma Tag 00T4 (lemma-base-change-smooth), implicit in the proof of Lemma Tag 0CAQ

proof.text: *The isomorphism $B\cong A\otimes_{A_i}B_i$ (Stacks: implicit in 'such that $B=B_i\otimes_{A_i}A$').* Regard $A$ as an $A_i$-algebra via $\iota_i$. The $A_0$-algebra structure of $A$ through $A_i$ is $\iota_i\circ g=j$ (step 2), the structure used in step 1. Hence [lem-weil-pbc-tensor-cancel-base-change] (with $R=A_0$, $S=A_i$, the $S$-algebra $A$ and the $R$-algebra $B_0$) gives an isomorphism of $A$-algebras $\psi:A\otimes_{A_i}B_i=A\otimes_{A_i}(A_i\otimes_{A_0}B_0)\xrightarrow{\sim}A\otimes_{A_0}B_0$, $a\otimes(s\otimes b)\mapsto\iota_i(s)a\otimes b$. Then $\psi^{-1}\circ\varphi:B\xrightarrow{\sim}A\otimes_{A_i}B_i$ is an isomorphism of $A$-algebras (a composite of two), and $i$ with the smooth ring map $A_i\to B_i$ of step 3 satisfies the statement.
